main_text.p: נִבְלָתָא נבלא Chal. Cadaver, Cadivum, Morticinum, quasi caducum aut deciduum, ut Heb. Namָ נְבֵל Heb. Cecidit, Concidit.
נבע Ch. Scaturire, Eructare, proprie de fontibus, aquam scaturientibus dicitur: & Metaphorice de sermone, Eloqui, proloqui. Aphel אַבִּיעַ & אַבַּע Idé: Sic S. נַבְּעָא Aquę scaturientes, Joh.4.14.
מבועא מבוע Ch. Fons, vena, scaturigo, scatebra. Sic Syriac. Jac.3.11. Plur. מבועין, const. מבועי מיין Scaturignes aquarum, Jef.49.10.
נבך Ch. Fodere, suffodere, vastare. Futur. ex forma Pohal, יִנּוּבְרְנָה Suffodiat eam, Psal.80.14. Hebr. יִכְרְסְמֶנָּה.
נבריא Chald. Latrones. Resp. Hebr. צמים, Jobi 18.9. Sed Jobi 5.5. transfertur לִסְטִיסִין.
נברשתא & נברשתא, נברשא Ch. Lychnuchus, Lucerna.
ננב Ch. Siccari, exsiccari, desiccari. Ithpehal אִתְנַנַּב Idem. Ex Pah. Part. נַפְשָׁנָא מִנְגְּבָא Anima nostra arida, Num.11.6. in Jon.
נניב Ch. Siccum. Foemin. נְגִיבְתָא, נְגִיבָא Arida, Sicca, Gen.1.10. in Jon.

נגר Ch. & Syr. Trahere, abstrahere, attrahere, extrahere, protrahere, subtrahere, subducere, ducere, diducere, extendere, inclinare. De variis rebus dicitur. De arcu, est Jaculari: de aquis, Fluere, Stillare:

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Greek-style vocalised words are copied as far as legible; several vowel points in the Hebrew and Chaldee words are doubtful and marked only in the faded scan. Some Hebrew lines (Pual/Hithpael forms, the line beginning "Et eructabo" and the mirrored Hebrew words) are only partly legible.
